column1: # name<TAB>install command<TAB>what it costs. Setup runs every command on each run (setup.sh --addons narrows the list), so
# each installs the add-on or updates it to its latest; none names a version.

column2: claude mcp remove serena -s local >/dev/null 2>&1; claude mcp add serena -- uvx --from git+https://github.com/oraios/serena serena start-mcp-server --context ide-assistant --project "$(pwd)"
column3: one language-server process per project; setup.sh --addons serena also turns on the hooks that use it (the read-tracker nudge and the pane-budget gate)
